title: A long-lived balance
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: In a main-sequence star, gravity pulls inward while pressure in the hot stellar material provides support. Fusion replenishes energy and helps maintain this balance.

misconception: A learner may choose: A solid surface around the star
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: What helps support a main-sequence star against gravity?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: What helps support a main-sequence star against gravity? Pressure associated with the hot gas and energy generated by fusion. In a main-sequence star, gravity pulls inward while pressure in the hot stellar material provides support. Fusion replenishes energy and helps maintain this balance.
Visual caption: Gravity and pressure balance. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.
